ops.body: - Outing journey step 1 (OJ1-OJ40, decision 0198) left for later: the near towns as shortcuts (OJ8, with step 2: it loads the gazetteer on opening the page); a press and hold on the map to set a destination; "Include chains" behind the sheet's pull-up (OJ16); attractions from the places archive (the tiles' own only); a check for the capture stack on the page (OJ39); the cold find and the UI review of the new page (decisions 0167, 0145); the opened journey's sheet covers part of its route on a small screen; steps 2 (the towns between, a line on each, no cap, variety) and 3 (the session's bar) and the road engine slice (0198)

- [ ] **Do:** on a phone, on Explore, tap "Plan an outing"; tap the field "Where to?", type a town an hour's drive away and pick it; switch chips on and off; swipe the journey cards; tap "See this journey"; then go back, close, open again and tap "Nowhere in particular". **Expect:** the page is the map with the field over it and a sheet below; the town shows with its distance "away"; the map moves to it; up to three cards scroll sideways one at a time and the map draws the one in view; a far town offers "When I get there" beside Start (alone past 10 km); around here the journey starts at once; the keyboard never covers the search results (OJ1-OJ4, OJ7, OJ9, OJ17)
